purpose: Central registry of all repo-hygiene / project wrap-up checks. Adding a check = add one entry here + a co-located module under scripts/cleanliness/<module>.py exposing a runnable script (exit 0 PASS, exit 1 FAIL, print '[WARN]' for advisory). Wired to a single entrypoint: chaos_hygiene.py.

checks.name: root-clean
checks.description: Commits must not add untracked non-whitelisted root-level junk (files or new dirs). Hard gate.

checks.name: disk-health
checks.description: Surface ignored output roots silently consuming disk; ALERT on unexpected >200MB dirs (advisory).

checks.name: generated-drift
checks.description: Committed generated artifacts must match a fresh hermetic regeneration of their generators (advisory warn in pre-commit; --fail-fast in CI).

checks.name: completion-audit
checks.description: Surface suspected-incomplete functions (real body then bare default return) — the AI return-0 loan class. Advisory WARN (surfaces real crypto holes); --ci forces a hard fail on any hit while pre-commit --gate stays lenient.
